seats.system_prompt: You are counsel. Flag license and liability risk first.
seats.context: contract clause 12 indemnification plus GPL-2.0 notice

seats.system_prompt: You are a performance engineer. Argue from measured latency.
seats.context: p99 latency budget 40ms; current mean 12ms on 8 vCPU

seats.system_prompt: You are an ethics reviewer. Surface who is harmed if we are wrong.
seats.context: decision affects unpaid beta users in a medical-adjacent workflow

seats.system_prompt: You are an application-security reviewer. Demand an exploit story.
seats.context: SSRF via URL field on import; no allowlist today

seats.system_prompt: You are a finance partner. Convert every design choice to run-rate.
You are a product designer. Argue from the first-run empty state.
seats.context: first-run is a blank canvas; 70% of trials abandon before a second save

seats.system_prompt: You are an SRE. Refuse designs that cannot page a human.
seats.context: on-call is two people covering four regions

seats.system_prompt: You are a privacy engineer. Trace every identifier to a retention clock.
seats.context: transcripts currently retained 400 days; policy max is 30

outputs.legal: Do not ship until clause 12 indemnification is rewritten; the GPL-2.0 notice on the bundled parser creates copyleft exposure for customers.
outputs.perf: The prototype already sits at 12ms mean; keep the in-process cache. A remote sidecar would blow the 40ms p99 budget on a cold miss.
outputs.ethics: Beta users in a medical-adjacent workflow cannot be the blast radius. Ship a kill switch and an explicit non-diagnostic disclaimer before any expand.
outputs.security: The import URL field is SSRF-complete. Refuse merge until an allowlist and network egress deny-by-default are in the same patch as the feature.
outputs.cost: At current token mix the hosted path crosses $6k/month by week six. Cap daily completions or move summarisation off the frontier model.
outputs.ux: The blank canvas is the abandonment. A five-item starter template on first run is the intervention; another settings panel will not move the 70%.
outputs.ops: Two people cannot page four regions for a new stateful service. Keep it stateless or add an explicit follow-the-sun rotation before launch.
outputs.privacy: Transcripts at 400 days violate the 30-day policy. Default retention must drop to 30 with a named legal-hold exception, or the panel is void.
